_about: Discovery two-option component (founder approval, 2 Nov 2026: Living in the Garden pilot). Two ways to explore ONE Discovery: explore the makers and products yourself, or enter that Discovery's EXISTING guided Journey. Rendered by atlas-tools/build-supplier-gallery.py beneath the gallery heading and figures, above the carousel, only for Discoveries listed here. A Discovery may be listed only when it has BOTH a supplier gallery / Maker Explorer AND an existing guided Journey with Atlas-matched results (see the 2 Nov 2026 Discovery audit). No new Journey, matching, intake or form. Guarded by atlas-tools/prove-discovery-two-option.py.

discovery-living-in-the-garden.html._reinstated: 2026-11-04, founder approval 'DISC-008 homeowner experience improvement': a compact A/B choice at the head of the consolidated supplier section, directly above the supplier cards and the Maker Explorer, so free help is offered before 570 products.
